# If

Executes one of two execution outputs based on the value of the input condition. If the condition is true, the top execution output will be used, and if the condition is false, the bottom execution output will be used.

## Categories

- Logic / Flow Control

## Usage

1. Trigger the chip through its execution input when you want the logic to run.
2. Match each input to the type or contract described below.
3. Read from or connect the documented outputs based on the chip result.

## Ports

### Inputs

- Run (exec) - The execution input to trigger the condition check
- Condition (bool) - The condition to evaluate

### Outputs

- Then (exec) - The execution output if the condition is true
- Else (exec) - The execution output if the condition is false

## Rules

- Match the chip behavior to the current port contract and chip config.
- If a value can resolve to multiple types, describe it as object in chip documentation and skript comments.
- If the chip can fail in a known way, document the error token in the usage markdown.

## Example

`If(condition)`
